svg.title: Pixhella — Entrepreneurial / Photo · Completed
svg.desc: Co-founded within Easivio. A photo-sharing network with a print service: photo books and prints from the phone, Google Photos, Instagram and Facebook. Stack: Flutter · Firebase · Ci/Cd.
